topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Well, isn’t that something now? I remember old Master Thomas from when I was a lad, and to hear that my own Jonny’s learned to read by his hand, it stirs memories both old and new. I’ve been thinking about the old cider orchard, where we’d sneak off for a sip during the long, hot days. It’s a comfort, in a way, to know some things stay the same, even as the years turn the soil over and over. But, you see, I also worry if the ways of old are still fit for today’s world. Jonny, he seems a bright boy, but these days, with the world turning so fast, I can’t help but wonder if Master Thomas’s teachings will serve him well. I’ll have to speak with him, see what he thinks of the world now.
